messages:
emma: Quick sync: Orion (HW partner) asked for a compact perf/W + thermal sweep next Wed. They want publishable plots for marketplace listing. Who can own harness and run artifacts?
rafael: Orion PM here. We'll provide clamp-meter CSVs and onboard sensor streams. Embargo until Fri 16:00 UTC. Targets: tokens/s, perf/W, p99 for batch=1 and batch=8 at seq=128 and seq=512.
jun: I can own the harness. Plan: run baseline fp16 + int8-tuned + two kernel branches (k2, k2-tuned). Need the exact prompt set and seed. Also confirm power sync rate (1Hz ok?).
priya: Ops: reserving dedicated-pool-3 Tue-Wed. Please drop OCI tag and partner SSH before EOD Mon. We'll capture IPMI + external meter. Agree on 1Hz sampling and 100ms timestamp align.
emma: Acceptance criteria draft: Cerulean-6B fp16 >=2.0 tokens/s/W at seq=512 batch=8 AND p99 <300ms at seq=128 batch=1. Kernel candidate if >=5% tokens/s uplift with <=0.5W increase. Cross-validate clamp vs onboard within 7%.
jun: Sample run command: ```benchctl start --model cerulean-6b --build k2-tuned --seq 512 --batch 8 --power-source clamp --out s3://redwood-bench/orion/214300```
bench-bot: kickoff job 214300 by jun. Sample log:
[RUN] model=cerulean-6b build=k2-tuned batch=8 seq=512 tokens/s=10.6 power=5.3W perf/W=2.00 p99=285ms
[KV] warm=true hit=92%
[THERM] board=58C ambient=24C
rafael: Good initial numbers. We'll coordinate NDA review and blog timeline after you upload full artifacts.
emma: I'll draft runbook + plot templates and post here by Mon noon. React with :white_check_mark: when you have OCI tag/creds. Thanks!
